sql.ahj.list: SELECT ahj.id, ahj.name, ahj.metro_area_id, lov.name as metro_area, cs.id as company_state_id, cs.state_id, s.state, s.abbreviation as state_abbreviation, ahj.archived FROM brs.ahj ahj LEFT JOIN flow.list_of_value lov ON lov.id = ahj.metro_area_id left join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = ahj.company_state_id left join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id WHERE ahj.archived IS NOT TRUE ORDER BY s.state, lov.name, ahj.name
sql.ahj.findById: SELECT ahj.id, ahj.name, ahj.metro_area_id, lov.name as metro_area, cs.id as company_state_id, cs.state_id, s.state, s.abbreviation as state_abbreviation, ahj.archived FROM brs.ahj ahj LEFT JOIN flow.list_of_value lov ON lov.id = ahj.metro_area_id left join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = ahj.company_state_id left join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id WHERE ahj.id = :id
sql.ahj.checkForDuplicate: SELECT ahj.id, ahj.name, ahj.metro_area_id, lov.name as metro_area, cs.id as company_state_id, cs.state_id, s.state, s.abbreviation as state_abbreviation, ahj.archived FROM brs.ahj ahj LEFT JOIN flow.list_of_value lov ON lov.id = ahj.metro_area_id left join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = ahj.company_state_id left join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id WHERE ahj.name = :name AND ahj.metro_area_id = :metroAreaId AND ahj.archived IS NOT TRUE
sql.ahj.create: INSERT INTO brs.ahj (name, metro_area_id, date_created, created_by_id, date_modified, modified_by_id, company_state_id) VALUES (:name, :metroAreaId, now(), :currentUser, now(), :currentUser, :companyStateId)
sql.ahj.update: UPDATE brs.ahj SET name = :name, metro_area_id = :metroAreaId, company_state_id = :companyStateId, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser WHERE id = :id
sql.ahj.delete: UPDATE brs.ahj SET archived = TRUE, date_modified = now() WHERE id = :id
sql.ahj.contact.create: INSERT INTO brs.ahj_contact (name, title, email, phone_number, address, notes, hours, date_created, created_by_id, date_modified, modified_by_id, contact_type_id) VALUES (:name, :title, :email, :phoneNumber, :address, :notes, :hours, now(), :currentUser, now(), :currentUser, :contactTypeId)
sql.ahj.contact.update: UPDATE brs.ahj_contact SET name = :name, title = :title, email = :email, phone_number = :phoneNumber, address = :address, notes = :notes, hours = :hours, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser WHERE id = :contactId
sql.ahj.contact.delete: UPDATE brs.ahj_contact SET archived = TRUE, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser WHERE id = :contactId
